items.title: Pilgrim Woman Kneading Bread
items.alt: A woman in a blue waistcoat, linen coif and apron kneads a round of dough at a complete wooden trestle table.
items.description: A woman in a blue waistcoat, linen coif and apron kneads a round of dough at a complete wooden trestle table. An original historical illustration for personal projects and classroom activities.

items.title: Pilgrim Cooking Pot at the Hearth
items.alt: A woman in muted red and brown clothing stirs an iron cooking pot beside a small bounded masonry hearth and wooden table.

items.title: Pilgrim Preparing Cornmeal
items.alt: A woman in an ochre waistcoat and linen coif uses a long wooden pestle in a tall wooden mortar containing dried corn.

items.title: Pilgrim Herb Preparation Table
